title: Look Closer
topic: Attention: what you stop for comes alive
core_message: Most things stay ordinary because nobody stops for them. One step closer, one minute of real attention, and the ordinary thing starts to reveal what was inside it all along.
visual_metaphor: A generated 5-second shot: a man takes one slow step toward an object; as his foot lands the object wakes with an inner glow and the air ripples. The episode frames that single shot: hook line over the darkened first frame, the shot plays once, then a slow push-in on the glowing last frame while the payoff lands.

clip.source_note: Kling 5 s shot, 1076x1844 @ 24 fps, generated from a reference image; its own audio track is not used

narration_style: quiet, curious, unhurried; a pause before the last line

narration.text: Most things stay ordinary, because nobody stops.
Then someone takes one step closer.
And the ordinary thing begins to speak.

caption_density: one short line per sentence; nothing during the end card
